summary: Phase 2 (Group Chat + Mobile Responsive + Message Search + Attachment cards) — FULL backend + frontend regression PASS. All 33 Phase-1 tests still green; 23 new Phase-2 tests added and green (56/56 total). UI verified: new-group-btn opens GroupCreateDialog, group creation works, chat header opens GroupInfoDialog with edit/add/leave/promote/demote/kick, in-chat message search filters correctly, mobile (390px) hides sidebar when chat is open, chat-back-btn navigates back, drawer-toggle-btn opens slide-in nav drawer, no horizontal scrolling on mobile, no console errors.

issues: chat-msg-search Input has fixed width w-44 — long search queries are visually truncated (input still functions correctly, only cosmetic).

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) Widen chat-msg-search input or make it expand on focus so users can see full query while typing.

(Optional) De-duplicate the data-testid='drawer-close-btn' — two elements share it (one in drawer header, one in the original AppLayout structure). Functionality works but unique testids are preferable.
(Carryover from prev iteration, still optional) Split server.py (~940 lines) into routers/{auth,admin,chats,groups,files,socketio}.py — file is past the 700-line threshold per code-review guidelines.
(Carryover) Make /admin/users/{id}/approve accept AdminUserAction body for consistency with reject/suspend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 700-line guidance (~940 lines) — group endpoints would naturally split into /routers/groups.py.
_get_or_create_chat correctly filters {is_group: {$ne: true}} so a stale 1:1 chat between A and B won't be confused with a group chat sharing the same 2-member participants list — good.
send_message validation correctly handles peer_id|chat_id either-or; group messages set receiver_id=None and seed read_by=[sender]; new_message echoes back to sender too.
POST /chats/{id}/read for group chats uses $addToSet on read_by[] (idempotent) and emits messages_read to all other members — correct.
Last-admin protection on demote_admin (returns 400) prevents lockout. Leave-group auto-promotion of first remaining participant is correct.
GET /api/search/messages scope correctly restricted to chats where requester is a participant ($in chat_ids).

ChatPage filteredMessages filter is case-insensitive and matches only message text (NOT attachment.name). Attachment-only messages won't appear in results when searching by file name — consider extending filter to include attachment.name.

GroupCreateDialog uses input[type=file] for group-icon-input but no upload to backend visible in the dialog code path — main agent should confirm the icon is being uploaded via /api/files/profile-picture or similar before group creation (currently group icon may be silently dropped).
Two elements with data-testid='drawer-close-btn' (AppLayout line 51 has duplicates in the rendered tree on mobile — desktop close + drawer close). Prefer unique testids per element.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (group create, group info, group send, msg search, mobile responsive, drawer, back nav, no h-scroll)

seed_data_creation: test_phase2_groups.py self-seeds 3+ approved test users with time+random suffixed mobiles (collision-free). It does NOT cleanup; admin can prune TEST_-prefixed users via Admin > All Users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 + Phase 2 fully green via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; Phase 2 group regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_groups.py. Both are idempotent. Socket.IO mount path is still /api/socket.io. Group message socket fields verified: is_group=true, receiver_id=null, status='sent', read_by[]=[sender]. 'messages_read' emits to all non-sender participants on POST /chats/{id}/read. Typing event accepts both {peer_id,typing} and {chat_id,typing} with chat_id echoed back to recipients. If main agent later adds: group message reactions, edit/delete, push notifications, mute/pin — add tests there.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found this iteration. Phase 2 backend additions (groups CRUD, search, group socket broadcast, group read_by tracking) and frontend additions (GroupCreateDialog, GroupInfoDialog, mobile responsive layout, drawer, message search) all work as specified. The only cosmetic note is that the chat-msg-search field is narrow (w-44) — purely visual, not blocking.
